name: claude-in-codex
description: Control Claude Code from Codex: routed delegation with independent verification, code review, persistent sessions, job steering, pair and council modes, and an agent message bus.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate to, talk with, and coordinate Claude Code
interface.longDescription: Hand coding tasks to headless Claude Code with automatic Haiku/Sonnet/Opus routing, independent verification and repair retries; get Claude reviews of local changes; hold persistent multi-turn sessions; steer or cancel running jobs; run Claude/Codex pair-programming loops and Claude/Codex/Gemini councils; and connect agents over a file-based message bus. Requires the cic CLI and exec-policy rule from install.sh.
defaultPrompt: Use $claude-delegate to have Claude fix the failing test and verify it.
Use $claude-review to get Claude's review of my uncommitted changes.
Use $claude-council to compare our options with Claude, Codex, and Gemini.
